```plato
//==
// # Quaternion arithmetic and construction
//
// Portable reference bodies for the quaternion operations that used to be host
// intrinsics. Every formula is a faithful port of System.Numerics.Quaternion
// (https://github.com/microsoft/referencesource — System.Numerics/Quaternion.cs),
// including operand order and branch structure, so host and portable evaluation
// agree bit-for-bit.
//
// The rotation *conversions* (axis-angle, Euler, rotor, matrix embeddings) live in
// `transforms.library.plato`; this file holds only the algebra and the
// three `Create*` constructors.
//
// https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quaternions_and_spatial_rotation

library RotationsOps
{
    //==
    // Magnitude and normalization

    // The dot product of the two quaternions, taken over all four components.
    Dot(self: Quaternion, quaternion2: Quaternion): Number
        => self.X * quaternion2.X + self.Y * quaternion2.Y
         + self.Z * quaternion2.Z + self.W * quaternion2.W;
```
